title: Inventory Reorder Plan
description: A protected buying sheet: eight weeks of sales with sparklines, weeks of cover and a reorder flag as live formulas, and yellow input cells with dropdowns and limits.
developerHook: Hand people a sheet they can safely edit: locked formulas, validated inputs, and statuses that react as they type.

preview.playgroundSummary: Fourteen SKUs with weekly sales, cover and a reorder flag computed in Excel. Buyers pick a supplier and type quantities in validated, unlocked cells; everything else is protected.
